dev_only_manual_semantic_evidence.interpretation: A persistent final-odds representation exists. The displayed timestamp is after scheduled start, so this observation alone does not prove that the final values were observable/executable before betting cutoff or race start.

provider_help_semantics.finding: Past-race navigation identifies the odds view as each race's exact/final odds (確定オッズ).
provider_help_semantics.limitation: This still does not prove pre-cutoff executability or authorize bulk acquisition/storage.
